name: 🌙 Jump Rope to the Moon!
desc:
One rope. One giant leap. How high can YOU go? 🌎
Inspired by Scarlet Skips
Time your jumps, stack powerful upgrades, and turn a simple skipping session into a trip to the MOON! 🔥 Ignite your rope, build wild combos, and keep climbing—every successful skip brings you closer.
🪢 Master your timing
🔥 Stack upgrades and discover powerful combos
🎨 Show off your favorite rope skins
🌙 Beat your best and shoot for the moon!
The sky is only the beginning.
